snippet.title: Republic of Pirates - Announcement Trailer | PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2023
snippet.description:
Establish a Pirate settlement and expand through the region in Republic of Pirates. In this city-builder you'll create effective networks in a resource based economy, build powerful fleets to command in realtime against your enemies, and conquer new territories as you go.

The PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted is an event highlighting the 25 most exciting games in development on PC. A group of 70 expert panellists including critics, industry luminaries, and content creators dubbed The Council, scored a wide range of games which when all considered determined the 25 selected.
